Run the full configured statci verification pipeline on a project

Source: R/config.R
statci_audit_project.Rd

Orchestrates statistical AST linting, optional manuscript-to-code auditing, optional programmatic estimator/SBC/parallel RNG/sensitivity/power-curve audits, report rendering (HTML, Markdown, JSON, and/or SARIF 2.1.0), and optional CI gate enforcement in a single call driven by .statci.yml.

Usage

statci_audit_project(
  path = ".",
  config = NULL,
  estimator = NULL,
  sbc = NULL,
  parallel_rng = NULL,
  sensitivity = NULL,
  power_curve = NULL,
  multiverse = NULL,
  enforce_gate = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Root project directory (default ".").

config

One of:

  • A "statci_config" object from read_statci_config();

  • Path to a .statci.yml file; or

  • NULL (auto-discovers file.path(path, ".statci.yml") if present, otherwise uses sensible defaults).

estimator

Optional "statci_estimator_audit" object to include.

sbc

Optional "statci_sbc" object to include.

parallel_rng

Optional "statci_parallel_rng" object to include.

sensitivity

Optional "statci_sensitivity" object to include.

power_curve

Optional "statci_power_curve" object to include.

multiverse

Optional "statci_multiverse" object to include.

enforce_gate

Logical; if TRUE, calls statci_check_gate() using config$gate$fail_on. Default FALSE.

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_report" (with $config and $artifacts attached when reports are written to disk).

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("statci_proj_")
dir.create(file.path(tmp, "R"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(c("set.seed(42)", "x <- rnorm(20)"), file.path(tmp, "R", "sim.R"))
rep <- statci_audit_project(tmp)
rep
#> [PASS] statci Statistical CI/CD Audit Report
#> [PASS] AST Statistical Linter: 1 file(s), 0 finding(s) (0 error, 0 warning, 0
#> info)
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
